item.description: North Carolina is restoring its coastal peatlands by bringing water back to areas damaged by drainage, farming and timber activities. The projects aim to reduce the risk of severe peat fires while keeping carbon stored in wet soils. At Pocosin Lakes National Wildlife Refuge, 37,000 acres have been restored, with water-control structures helping recreate natural water movement. Similar work at Angola Bay Game Land is restoring ditched peatland and wetland habitat. item.title: A 13-year-old crawled into a Tennessee cave and found a hidden lake
item.description: In 1905, a 13-year-old boy stumbled upon America's largest underground lake in Craighead Caverns, Tennessee.
